verdict.rationale: Reducto's docs say Parse performs OCR as part of processing and handles rotated pages and forms with handwriting, which covers part of the scanned-document story. The docs never specifically address skewed or deskewed pages, stamps, photographed documents, or low-quality scans. Missing for 10: explicit support for skew correction, stamp handling, photographed-document input, low-quality-scan robustness, and independent or hands-on accuracy corroboration on scanned inputs.
